name: computer-use-demo
tagline: Where Claude looks at a screen, moves the mouse, and types commands in a loop
summary: A demo that lets Claude drive a Linux desktop inside a Docker container. A Streamlit page takes your message, then a sampling loop keeps calling the Claude API and running the tools Claude asks for (screen/mouse/keyboard, bash, file editor) until Claude stops asking. Tool versions decide which tools and beta headers are sent.

entities.name: Streamlit chat page
entities.summary: The web page you open at port 8080. It shows the chat, takes your message and starts the sampling loop.
entities.details:
- Started by image/entrypoint.sh after the virtual desktop is up
- Re-renders the whole chat on every Streamlit run
- Your message is added to the conversation, then sampling_loop is awaited
- Callbacks render Claude's text, tool results and raw HTTP logs as they arrive

entities.name: Settings sidebar
entities.summary: The left panel where you pick the API provider, model, tool version, image limit and thinking mode.
entities.details:
- Provider radio: anthropic, bedrock or vertex
- 'Only send N most recent images' defaults to 3
- Tool Versions radio lists every ToolVersion
- Thinking options shown depend on the model's config
- Reset button kills Xvfb and tint2 and restarts the desktop

entities.name: Provider credentials check
entities.summary: Before the chat appears, checks that the chosen provider has credentials.
entities.details:
- Anthropic: API key must not be empty
- Bedrock: boto3 must find AWS credentials
- Vertex: CLOUD_ML_REGION must be set and Google default credentials must load
- Runs once; then auth_validated is set to True

source.anchor: def validate_auth(provider: APIProvider, api_key: str | None):

guard.rule: The chosen API provider must have usable credentials
guard.checks: API key present (Anthropic), AWS credentials (Bedrock), CLOUD_ML_REGION + Google creds (Vertex)
guard.onFail: A warning with the auth problem is shown and the chat is not rendered

entities.name: Sampling loop
entities.summary: The heart of the demo: calls Claude, runs every tool Claude asks for, sends the results back, and repeats.
entities.details:
- Builds the tool list from the chosen tool version
- Each turn: call API, append Claude's reply, run each tool_use block
- Tool results go back as a user message, then the loop runs again
- Stops when a reply has no tool_use blocks, or on an API error
- Toolset member calls run in order and stop at the first failure

agent.role: Controls a Linux desktop by looking at screenshots and using mouse, keyboard, shell and file tools

entities.name: Screenshot trimmer and prompt cache
entities.summary: Keeps the conversation affordable: either caches it (Anthropic) or drops old screenshots (Bedrock/Vertex).
entities.details:
- On Anthropic: adds cache breakpoints to the 3 newest user turns and sets image trimming to 0
- Comment says cached reads cost 10%, so breaking the cache is not worth it
- Otherwise: removes all but the N newest screenshot images
- Removes images in chunks of N so the cache breaks less often

guard.rule: Old screenshots must not blow up the prompt size
guard.checks: Anthropic: cache_control on 3 newest user turns; others: count tool_result images vs only_n_most_recent_images
guard.onFail: Older images are silently removed from tool results before the API call

entities.name: System prompt
entities.summary: Fixed instructions telling Claude about the Ubuntu VM, Firefox, DISPLAY=:1 and today's date, plus an optional suffix you type in the sidebar.
entities.details:
- Built once at import, so the date is the date the app started
- Tips: use curl not wget, ignore the Firefox wizard, redirect big output to a file
- Sidebar 'Custom System Prompt Suffix' is appended and saved to ~/.anthropic/system_prompt

entities.name: Tool versions and model configs
entities.summary: Maps each tool version to its tool classes and beta header, and each model name to a tool version and thinking modes.
entities.details:
- 5 tool groups, e.g. computer_use_20251124 adds zoom
- computer_toolset_20260801 has beta_flag=None (GA, no beta header)
- Every group pairs a computer tool with the same edit tool and a bash tool
- Unknown model IDs fall back to DEFAULT_MODEL_CONF after a longest-prefix match

entities.name: Conversation messages
entities.summary: The list of user and assistant messages kept in Streamlit session state and sent to Claude every turn.
entities.details:
- Lives in st.session_state.messages
- The loop appends Claude's replies and the tool results in place
- If you interrupt mid-loop, fake 'human stopped' tool results are added to heal the history
- Tool outputs for display are kept separately in st.session_state.tools

entities.name: Claude API (Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex)
entities.summary: The model endpoint. The loop picks an Anthropic, AnthropicBedrock or AnthropicVertex client by provider.
entities.details:
- Only the Anthropic client gets the API key and max_retries=4
- Uses the raw-response form so HTTP logs can be shown
- Sends betas only if there are any (toolset group has none)
- On any API error the loop reports it and returns

entities.name: Tool router and error catcher
entities.summary: Finds the tool Claude named, runs it, and turns any ToolError into an error result that goes back to Claude.
entities.details:
- Unknown tool name gives 'Tool X is invalid'
- Toolset calls are routed by toolset_name, the member name becomes the action
- Only ToolError is caught; other exceptions escape
- _make_api_tool_result sets is_error=True and adds <system> notes

guard.rule: Tool failures must reach Claude as error results, not crash the app
guard.checks: tool name exists in tool_map / toolset_map; ToolError raised while running
guard.onFail: A ToolFailure with the message is sent back as a tool_result with is_error=true

entities.name: Computer tool (screen, mouse, keyboard)
entities.summary: Moves the mouse, clicks, types and takes screenshots on the virtual X display (Xvfb on :1) using xdotool.
entities.details:
- Most actions wait 2s, then return a fresh screenshot
- Coordinates are scaled between screenshot size and real screen size (XGA/WXGA/FWXGA targets)
- Typing is sent in 50-character chunks
- 20251124 adds zoom; the 20260801 toolset makes each action its own member tool

entities.name: Bash tool
entities.summary: Runs shell commands in one long-lived bash process, so cd and variables stick between calls.
entities.details:
- Session starts lazily on the first command
- Each command is followed by echo '<<exit>>' so the tool knows it finished
- Reads stdout/stderr straight from the stream buffers
- restart: true stops the old shell and starts a new one

entities.name: Bash timeout
entities.summary: Gives each bash command 120 seconds. After a timeout the session is marked dead until Claude restarts it.
entities.details:
- Polls the output every 0.2s looking for the sentinel
- On timeout sets _timed_out=True and raises ToolError
- Later commands fail with the same message until restart
- If bash itself exited, returns an error with system note 'tool must be restarted'

guard.rule: A bash command may not run longer than 120 seconds
guard.checks: sentinel '<<exit>>' seen in stdout within _timeout; session not already timed out or exited
guard.onFail: ToolError 'timed out: bash has not returned in 120.0 seconds and must be restarted'

entities.name: File editor tool
entities.summary: Lets Claude view, create, str_replace and insert in files (text_editor_20250728, named str_replace_based_edit_tool).
entities.details:
- view shows files with line numbers, or a directory 2 levels deep
- create refuses to overwrite an existing file
- str_replace and insert return a small snippet around the change
- This version has no undo_edit command

entities.name: Edit checks
entities.summary: Stops bad edits: the path must be absolute and exist, and old_str must appear exactly once.
entities.details:
- Relative path is rejected
- create on an existing file is rejected; other commands on a missing file are rejected
- Directories only allow view
- str_replace counts old_str: 0 = not found, more than 1 = lists the line numbers

source.anchor: def validate_path(self, command: str, path: Path):

guard.rule: Edits must target a real absolute path and an unambiguous old_str
guard.checks: path.is_absolute(), path.exists(), not a directory, file_content.count(old_str) == 1
guard.onFail: ToolError explaining the problem; the file is not touched

entities.name: File edit history
entities.summary: An in-memory map from file path to the list of earlier file contents, saved on every create, str_replace and insert.
entities.details:
- A defaultdict(list) on the edit tool instance
- Stores the whole old file text each time
- Nothing reads it: this tool version has no undo_edit
- Lost when the loop ends, since tools are rebuilt per sampling_loop call

quests.title: Ride the loop
quests.prompt: Watch one full sampling loop: your message, Claude's tool call, the tool result, and the final answer.

quests.title: Where did my limit go?
quests.prompt: Provider is Anthropic and the sidebar says 'Only send N most recent images' = 3. After 10 screenshots, how many screenshots are sent to Claude?
options: All 10, because trimming is turned off to keep the prompt cache
quests.explain: When provider is Anthropic, the loop sets only_n_most_recent_images = 0 because cached reads are cheaper than breaking the cache.

quests.title: Three of a kind
quests.prompt: Claude asks to replace 'return None' but the file has it on 3 lines. What happens?
quests.explain: occurrences > 1, so edit-checks raises a ToolError listing the line numbers.

quests.title: Stuck shell
quests.prompt: A 'sleep 300' just timed out. Claude now sends command='ls'. What does it get?
quests.explain: _timed_out stays True on the session, so every new command raises a ToolError until Claude calls bash with restart: true.

quests.title: Domino clicks
quests.prompt: With computer_toolset_20260801, Claude sends three member calls in one reply and the first one fails. What happens to the other two?
options: They get a 'Not executed: an earlier computer action in this turn failed.' error without running
The loop stops and returns to you
quests.explain: member_call_failed is set after the first failure; later member calls get NOT_EXECUTED_ERROR as a ToolFailure.

quests.title: Who reads the history?
quests.prompt: The edit tool saves the old file text in _file_history on every edit. What uses it?
options: Nothing: text_editor_20250728 has no undo_edit, so it is only written
It is sent to Claude each turn
quests.explain: The docstring says this version does not support undo_edit, and no code reads _file_history.

quests.title: When does it stop?
quests.prompt: Besides an API error, when does sampling_loop return on its own?
options: When Claude's reply has no tool_use blocks
When any tool returns an error
When the screenshot count hits N
quests.explain: If tool_result_content is empty after scanning the reply, the loop returns. Tool errors are sent back and the loop continues.

cracks.title: Out-of-bounds check uses the wrong size
cracks.hint: Claude's coordinates are in screenshot pixels. What size are they compared to?
cracks.finding: scale_coordinates checks API coordinates against the real screen size (self.width/height), not the smaller screenshot size. On a 1920x1080 screen the screenshot is 1366x768, so x=1500 passes the check and is scaled up to about 2108, which is off the screen.
cracks.suggestion: Compare API coordinates against target_dimension (the screenshot size) before scaling up.
decoys: Scaling rounds coordinates instead of flooring them
The 2-second screenshot delay is too short

source.anchor: if x > self.width or y > self.height:

cracks.title: Bash output is never cut down
cracks.hint: run.py has a 16000 character limit. Does the bash session use it?
cracks.finding: _BashSession.run returns the whole stdout and stderr buffer with no maybe_truncate. A command like 'cat big.log' puts all of it into the conversation, which can blow the context window and cost a lot, and it is resent every turn.
cracks.suggestion: Pass output and error through maybe_truncate (MAX_RESPONSE_LEN) like the edit and computer tools do.
decoys: The sentinel '<<exit>>' could be printed by the command itself
The 0.2s poll delay makes commands slow

cracks.title: A bad ToolError call crashes the loop
cracks.hint: ToolError takes one argument called message. Look at the 'must be a string' check.
cracks.finding: computer.py raises ToolError(output=...), but ToolError.__init__ only accepts message. If Claude sends non-string text for key/type, Python raises TypeError instead. The router only catches ToolError, so the TypeError escapes sampling_loop and crashes the Streamlit run instead of going back to Claude.
cracks.suggestion: Use ToolError(f"{text} must be a string"), and consider catching Exception in ToolCollection.run.
decoys: Unknown tool names are not reported
is_error is never set on failures

source.anchor: raise ToolError(output=f"{text} must be a string")
